commit_title: [patch] Apply a requirement stated at the end of a list to the whole list (#581)
commit_message:
The prompt parser states a requirement in two places: before the fields it covers
("Require email and phone.") and after them ("Name and email are required."). Only the first
form reached back over a list, so "Name and email are required." marked only Email required
and left Name optional.

A trailing requirement now reaches back over the fields its subject covers. The subject is the
coordinated chain the field belongs to: the fields joined to it by "and" or "as well as", and
the fields of a plain comma-separated list. An explicit coordinator completes a phrase, so a
comma after one starts a new group; a negation or a singular copula names one field; and an
excluded field ends the chain it belonged to.

The chain is tracked by reference, so removing an excluded field from the draft cannot shift
the other fields around it.

Co-authored-by: Alan Deffenderfer <deffenda@users.noreply.github.com>
